about: A truly unique wizarding experience inspired by classical fantasy fiction that lets you feel what it’s like to have magical powers. Waltz of the Wizard includes hours of content, humorous characters, ultra-interactive details and many curious secrets to discover. Your journey begins in a magical tower where you combine arcane ingredients into a boiling cauldron with the help of your strange skull assistant, Skully. For those who wish for even stranger things, embark on a mysterious adventure beyond the wizard's tower and explore more of the highly detailed, handcrafted world.
💀 Chat with your assistant Skully, who can talk and has thousands of reactions!
🧞 Discover absurdly detailed secrets in every corner, scavenger hunts and riddles.
💥 Unleash dozens of magical powers to bend the laws of physics to your will!
🚀 Try out some truly strange activities with Skully, including medieval rockets.
⚔️ Large campaign with storyline and challenges when you venture outside your tower.
🎙️ Hundreds of voice interactions, where you can use your natural voice.
🏰 Infinite level generation mode for endless fun in the fortress exploration.
🖐️ Full hand tracking support for PS VR2 players.
